name: Rogue
resourceDesc: Focus (0-100) pays for every move and comes back fast; combo points (0-5) build on one target with Sinister Strike and Gouge and are spent by Eviscerate.
identity: A quiet blade who decides which fights happen: Sap one before the pull, Gouge or Blind one in it, Kick the blow that matters, Vanish when it goes wrong. (GAME-ONLY kit on Valen's CANON line.)

branches.name: Thief's Grace
branches.loop: Sneak up, Sap the one you don't want, open on the rest; Vanish to reset a bad pull.

nodes.name: Long Sap
nodes.desc: Sap holds 10 seconds longer per rank.

nodes.name: Quiet Hands
nodes.desc: After Vanish, mobs lose sight of you 4 seconds longer per rank.

nodes.name: Light Step
nodes.desc: You move 4% faster while sneaking per rank.

nodes.name: Second Sap
nodes.desc: Sap costs 5 less Focus per rank.

nodes.name: Shadow Shift
nodes.desc: Vanish's cooldown is 30 seconds shorter per rank.

nodes.name: Light Fingers
nodes.desc: A Sap lifts a few coins from the mob's pocket; more per rank.

nodes.name: Thief's Grace
nodes.desc: Once a fight, a blow that would drop you misses instead.

nodes.name: Gone Clean
nodes.desc: Vanish gives back 10 Focus per rank.

nodes.name: Unremarked
nodes.desc: Mobs notice you 1 metre closer per rank.

branches.name: Shardwork
branches.loop: Build five points with Sinister Strike, spend them on Eviscerate, keep Focus from running dry.

nodes.name: Keen Edge
nodes.desc: Sinister Strike hits 4% harder per rank.

nodes.name: Ruthless
nodes.desc: Eviscerate hits 6% harder per point per rank.

nodes.name: Shard Poison
nodes.desc: Each swing has a 10% chance per rank to leave a burning shard in the wound.

nodes.name: Quick Blades
nodes.desc: You swing 5% faster per rank.

nodes.name: Relentless
nodes.desc: Eviscerate gives back 4 Focus per combo point spent, per rank.

nodes.name: Spent Shards
nodes.desc: Eviscerate hits a stunned, silenced or fleeing mob 30% harder.

nodes.name: Cut Deep
nodes.desc: A five-point Eviscerate leaves the wound bleeding for 8 seconds.

nodes.name: Spare Motion
nodes.desc: Sinister Strike costs 3 less Focus per rank.

nodes.name: Close Work
nodes.desc: Sinister Strike on a foe under 30% health builds two combo points.

branches.name: Locksmith
branches.loop: Kick the blows and casts that matter, Blind the runner, open the Adit's quiet gates.

nodes.name: Quick Kick
nodes.desc: Kick's cooldown is 2 seconds shorter per rank.

nodes.name: Fine Dust
nodes.desc: Blind lasts 2 seconds longer per rank.

nodes.name: Feel the Pins
nodes.desc: Gouge costs 5 less Focus per rank.

nodes.name: Ward-break
nodes.desc: Kick hits 50% harder per rank.

nodes.name: Tumblers
nodes.desc: Gouge holds 1 second longer per rank.

nodes.name: The Hum
nodes.desc: Kick also stuns for 1 second.

nodes.name: Vibration-locking
nodes.desc: Kick silences twice as long.

nodes.name: Practised Hands
nodes.desc: Kick costs 4 less Focus per rank.

nodes.name: Pocket of Dust
nodes.desc: Blind comes back 10 seconds sooner per rank.

branches.name: Swashbuckler
branches.loop: Open the foe up with Opening Cut so the whole party hits it harder, spend the combo on a Rallying Flourish to quicken you and Mira, and Tumble to its back for the blow that counts.
branches.tradeoff: Points spent on the party's pace are points not spent on Eviscerate: the Swashbuckler makes the fight quicker, not its own blows bigger.

nodes.name: Showmanship
nodes.desc: Opening Cut leaves the target Exposed 2s longer per rank.

nodes.name: Light Blade
nodes.desc: Opening Cut costs 5 less Focus per rank.

nodes.name: From Behind
nodes.desc: Your strikes from behind a foe land 4% harder per rank.

nodes.name: Long Flourish
nodes.desc: Rallying Flourish lasts 3s longer per rank.

nodes.name: Tumble
nodes.desc: New action: Tumble: roll past the target to its back; your next blow within 4s lands 30% harder, as from behind.

nodes.name: Wide Open
nodes.desc: An Exposed foe takes 2% more from the party per rank.

nodes.name: Encore
nodes.desc: A five-point Rallying Flourish also mends everyone in your party for 5% of their health.

nodes.name: Dashing
nodes.desc: Tumble's cooldown is 3s shorter per rank.

nodes.name: Panache
nodes.desc: Opening Cut gives two combo points.

nodes.name: Crowd Pleaser
nodes.desc: A foe dropped while Exposed gives back 10 Focus per rank.

nodes.name: Riposte
nodes.desc: For 2s after Tumble a blow at you is answered by a cut, per rank one more.

nodes.name: Grand Finale
nodes.desc: Eviscerate on an Exposed foe Exposes every foe within 8m.
